provenance.writtenFor: DROBON AEGIS original capability gap-closure master pump (2026-10-19)
provenance.kind: synthetic test fixture - NOT vulnerability intelligence

purpose: A flag attribute carries a value; browsers ignore attribute values for Secure and HttpOnly, so the cookie is protected and must not be reported.

groundTruth.rationale: RFC 6265 stores a cookie with the Secure and HttpOnly flags whenever the attribute names appear, regardless of their value. 'Secure=0' means the flag is on, so neither rule applies.

limitations: Observation mode: a synthetic response object, not a live request.
The rule does not judge whether 'Secure=0' is good style; it reports protection, not convention.
